messages:
Sasha (PM): Quick sync  rebalancing Optimize playbook: batching, prefix caching, quant recommendations, eval-triggered alerts. Customers pushing for cost cuts, mobile P95 <100ms, and faster regression alerts. I sketched three focus lanes: Cost, Latency, Quality. Need 304 4 launch gates by EOW. Thoughts?

Ravi (Eng): Agree on lanes. Propose splitting batching into runtime continuous batching (bigger cost win, infra risk) and SDK/client batching presets (lower risk).

Marta (ML): Quant path: deliver recommendation profiles (safe presets) with measured quality deltas. Start with Llama2 variants + two community models. Build an eval harness first.

Jules (Solutions): Customers want one-line value props and a migration checklist for Dedicated. Also Console presets: "Conserve tokens / Balanced / Low latency". Examples for RetailCo (30% token reduction target).

Kai (SRE): Ops guardrails: canary flows, token-level telemetry, per-route P95/P99 heatmaps, and circuit-breaker SLOs. Define rollback triggers (P99 spike or eval-alert surge).

Sasha (PM): Draft minimal gates: 1) Quant perf matrix for top-3 models + docs; 2) Batching policy with canary + SLO override; 3) Prefix caching opt-in + correctness checks; 4) Eval-alerts prototype + runbook. Keep them small so we can ship incrementally.

Ravi (Eng): We'll add explicit acceptance metrics: token reduction %, P95/P99 ceilings, and allowed eval-metric delta. I'll sketch numbers in the tech spec.

Marta (ML): Recommend per-customer relative thresholds (e.g., task recall drop <2%) and a small human-in-the-loop spot-check cadence initially.

Jules (Solutions): I'll map pilot customers to lanes (RetailCo=cost, AcmeHealth=accuracy, MobileApp=latency) and draft one-pagers.

Kai (SRE): Rollout recipe: canary 5% -> 25% over 24-48h; automated rollback if eval-alert rate >2% or P99 delta >50ms. Add a tiny chaos test for prefix-cache correctness.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot created epic RDW-1588 and linked PRD https://redwood.internal/epics/RDW-1588 :rocket:

Sasha (PM): Next steps: Ravi+Marta => tech spec + bench plan by Tue EOD; Jules => customer one-pagers; Kai => SLO guardrails + dashboards. Prioritization workshop Thurs 10am. Ping here for blockers. :+1:
